assets.title: 项目蓝图预览
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE beautiful, realistic desktop application screen for Workflow OS. The supplied local image is a STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Continue the exact existing product design: warm ivory flat canvas (#FAF8F3), subtly warmer left sidebar, deep forest green accents, near-black Chinese text, generous whitespace, fine neutral separators, tiny understated corner radii, no shadows except overlays. Chinese Song/Ming serif large headings, clean sans-serif UI controls, highly legible accurate simplified Chinese. No texture, gradients, illustrations, devices, browser chrome, poster surrounds or collage. Landscape approximately 1487x1058. Full app customer area within frame.
Preserve a 203px left sidebar and 65px top bar, brand Workflow OS. Sidebar exactly 今日 / 项目 / 任务 / 知识 / 动态 / 待审 with small outline icons; 连接 / 设置 at bottom. Never add a Skills marketplace or new primary navigation. Top right sample date 2026-09-19 星期六. Breadcrumb scoped to page, omit 通用/论文/开发 top tabs for these subflows. Main workspace from x240, optional 340px right decision rail separated by thin vertical line. Editorial main heading around 40px, body around 16px, plenty of breathing room. One clearly dominant green primary action. Footer tiny 设计概念 · 示例数据.
This is a design concept, all sample version names are illustrative. Render only supplied relevant UI copy; internal system terms belong in unobtrusive source details if needed, not giant labels. User-confirmed current facts must be clearly separated from AI suggestions. Never show completion just because AI generated text.

Central area titled 本次蓝图变更, clean spacious two-column comparison 当前 / 建议 with three rows: 下一步: 尚未明确 → 整理核心研究问题; 任务: 暂无任务 → 梳理研究问题、整理参考资料; 工作台: 通用 → 论文. Under task row a clear muted note 新任务进入收件箱，由我执行；不会自动开始.
Below thin divider, 后续配置建议 with two non-selected rows 引用核对规则 / 单独确认 and 验证配置 / 单独确认; small explanation 不随本次蓝图应用.
Right rail heading 确认这次变化, small summary 2 项新任务 / 1 项下一步 / 论文工作台. Show sources 已选来源: 项目目标 v1、研究笔记 v2. Main green button 应用这份蓝图; text links 修改建议 and 暂不采用. Note 暂不采用会保留已创建的项目. No implies rules or permissions applied; no new Goal creation; no success checks in pending proposal.
